entries.title: Romans 2:1
segments: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, everyone who judges; for in that in which you judge another, you condemn yourself, for you who judge do the same things.

entries.title: Romans 2:2
segments: But know that the judgment of God is according to truth on those who practice such things.

entries.title: Romans 2:3
segments: And, O man, the [one] judging those who do such things, and practice them, do you think this, that you shall escape the judgment of God?

entries.title: Romans 2:4
segments: Or do you despise the riches of His kindness, and the forbearance and long-suffering, not knowing that the kindness of God leads you to repentance?

entries.title: Romans 2:5
segments: But according to your hardness and your impenitent heart, do you treasure up wrath for yourself in a day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God,

entries.title: Romans 2:6
segments: who will render to each according to his works;

entries.title: Romans 2:7
segments: indeed to those who with patience [in] good work [are] seeking for glory, and honor, and incorruptibility, everlasting life.

entries.title: Romans 2:8
segments: But to those who even disobey the truth out of self-interest, but obey unrighteousness, [it will be] anger and wrath,

entries.title: Romans 2:9
segments: tribulation and anguish upon every soul of man who has worked out evil; of the Jew first, and also of the Greek.

entries.title: Romans 2:10
segments: But He [will give] glory, honor and peace to every man who works good, to [the] Jew first and also to [the] Greek.

entries.title: Romans 2:11
segments: For there is no respect of persons with God.

entries.title: Romans 2:12
segments: For as many as sinned without Law will also perish without Law. And as many as have sinned within Law shall be judged through Law.

entries.title: Romans 2:13
segments: For it is not the hearers of the Law who [are] just before God, but the doers of the Law will be justified.

entries.title: Romans 2:14
segments: For when the nations, who do not have the Law, do by nature the things of the Law, these, not having the Law, are a law unto themselves;

entries.title: Romans 2:15
segments: who show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and the thoughts between one another accusing or even excusing one another,

entries.title: Romans 2:16
segments: in a day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.

entries.title: Romans 2:17
segments: Behold, you are called a Jew, and rest in the Law, and boast in God;

entries.title: Romans 2:18
segments: and know [His] will and approve the things excelling, being instructed out of the Law;

entries.title: Romans 2:19
segments: and persuading yourselves to be a guide of the blind, a light to those in darkness;

entries.title: Romans 2:20
segments: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, who have the form of knowledge and of the truth in the Law.

entries.title: Romans 2:21
segments: Therefore the [one] teaching another, do you not teach yourself? The [one] preaching not to steal, do you steal?

entries.title: Romans 2:22
segments: The [one] saying not to commit adultery, do you commit adultery? The [one] detesting idols, do you rob temples?

entries.title: Romans 2:23
segments: [You] who boast in Law, do you dishonor God through breaking the Law?

entries.title: Romans 2:24
segments: For the name of God is blasphemed among the nations because of you, as it is written.

entries.title: Romans 2:25
segments: For circumcision truly profits if you keep [the] Law, but if you are a transgressor of the Law, circumcision becomes uncircumcision.

entries.title: Romans 2:26
segments: If then the uncircumcision keeps the ordinances of the Law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?

entries.title: Romans 2:27
segments: And the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfills the Law, shall it not judge you, who through letter and circumcision [become] transgressors of the Law?

entries.title: Romans 2:28
segments: For he is not a Jew who [is one] outwardly, nor [is] circumcision that outwardly in flesh;

entries.title: Romans 2:29
segments: but he [is] a Jew who [is one] inwardly, and circumcision [is] of the heart; in spirit and not in letter; whose praise [is] not from men, but from God.
